title: English Practice Quiz 0738
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: We ___ here since 2022.
questions.explanation: Since gives a starting point; the present perfect connects the past to now.

questions.question: When I was five, I ___ swim.
Which question asks for a reason?
___ student must bring an ID card.
questions.explanation: Each refers to every individual in a group.

questions.question: A person who repairs water pipes is a ___.
questions.explanation: A plumber installs and repairs water pipes and fittings.

questions.question: You did not hear someone. You say:
questions.explanation: Could you repeat that, please? is a polite request.

questions.question: Please ___ the correct answer.
questions.explanation: Choose is the base verb used after please.

questions.question: They finished ___ the room.
questions.explanation: Finish is followed by a gerund.

questions.question: Choose the best word: The road is very ___. There are many cars.
questions.explanation: Crowded means filled with many people or things; it can describe busy roads.

questions.question: Read: 'Mina takes the bus at 8 a.m. and reaches work at 8:45.' How does Mina travel?
questions.explanation: The passage clearly says Mina takes the bus.
